rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=200, epochs=11, batch_size=2, lr=0.0003, vn_T=4, vn_n_filters=32, vn_kernel=7, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_lambda_init=0.000327, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, max_train_s=1080, rationale=iter-2 (one knob: vn_T 3->4). Hypothesis: deeper unroll is the VNs native capacity axis on CT (adds one DC+learned-regulariser step), so hr should rise above iter-1 0.5083. Epochs cut 15->11 to offset the +33% per-step cost and stay under the 20-min wall (iter-1 was 1170s at T=3/ep=15).
